Hi,

I am trying to use the unmarked package and am having some difficulty with the implicit parallelization.

Can you tell me how you are setting the number of cores to use?  The behavior I am seeing is on my mac (R 3.2.4), I see about 50% of the cores being used.  When I move to our cluster, on a single node, I can’t seem to get more than 1.  

On the cluster, I am using gcc/5.2.0 openblas R/3.2.2

I am doing export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=24

I can easily compile an updated R with a different set of compilers/options if that is the answer.

Thanks,
Bob

Ok, seems I am thinking about this completely incorrectly.  On my laptop, what I am seeing is more like load balancing.  What I see on the compute node is simply showing me that thread is pegging a core.

Sorry for the confusion.
